tools.name: find_campaign_stories
tools.description: Search real charity stories a brand could fund as a cause-marketing campaign. Matches the query against titles, summaries, charities, causes and places, and returns the best matches with a link to each story page.

tools.name: get_campaign_story
tools.description: Get one story in full: the story, what a brand could do with it, and the charity's details.

tools.name: list_causes
tools.description: List the causes stories are filed under, with how many stories each has. Use a cause as the filter in a search.
